name: Big-Mover Momentum Strategy v1 (data-derived)
caveat: Derived on a winners-only databank: absolute expectancies are inflated by selection bias; relative policy/filter rankings are the robust output. Validate forward in sim before sizing up.

universe.note: momentum names; ADR sweet spot per trader preference

filter_descriptions.extension_lt50: stock is <50% above its move low (cold entry, not an add)
filter_descriptions.ordinal_le3: 1st–3rd entry signal of the move only (no late chasing)
filter_descriptions.spy_above_50: SPY above its 50SMA on entry day

initial_stop.description: low of the entry day (raw — EP style, can be very tight)

exit.description: exit next open after a close below the 50SMA

position_sizing.note: matches the 1R / 6R-heat caps in the Behavior Contract
